non_authoritative_commentary: Initial authorship, both blocked independent publication reviews, and both earlier corrective passes remain historical facts; none published this candidate.
The third independent implementation audit blocked after finding an output-family cardinality bypass, caller-controlled canonical-boundary substitution, and consequent stale verification truth.

The third bounded correction was implemented and internally verified, but the first independent correction audit on 2026-08-08 blocked after proving that a one-sided caller observation pair can still receive complete independently verified provenance when the omitted side is independently empty.

The fourth bounded correction now distinguishes argument suppliedness from empty bytes and forces every one-sided caller-observation case to remain incomplete and caller-supplied-unverified; the closed profile also represents the blocked audit and mutually exclusive re-audit branches without weakening prior history.

The fresh independent correction re-audit passed 79 executed probes with zero failures and one platform-capability device-node skip; report SHA-256 is 07b05e33d07f88154baa59cca1c05bc6097214878094165e4cb05e6aa8efbe64 and evidence identity is 4551d98d6d7ba1ed9cf26a2e945d834d192f3b96e14bdd28440c98f5ae58fd84.

At the predecessor report checkpoint, correction verification did not grant publication approval: the later closeout-consistency audit and publication reviews had not yet occurred, and the candidate was then unpublished, unstaged, uncommitted, and unpushed without publication authority.

After that checkpoint, the external final closeout-consistency audit evaluated predecessor aggregate 4821a68766df94b0e132effdabf5fb0f1c8e58e9f56769c998056915e965e894 and returned PASS. Its complete 134744-byte report is preserved in Hermes session macroforge-ignored-artifact-closeout-audit-20260808-874ad1a36b003638 at payload message 190901 with SHA-256 874ad1a36b0036386e36f17e15ccb92416c056f426a6b603ec1245dea6149b79 and evidence identity d809953c4fb5efe168ecff2c096575e63e8f94db84065522e9140a9a11e84e86; it is closeout evidence, not publication authority.

The subsequent fresh independent publication review returned BLOCKED / CANDIDATE DEFECT. It found implementation, evidence integrity, and the exact 15-path publication boundary sound, but blocked publication because this commentary and current state, handoff, and summary pointers retained stale or unqualified pre-final-audit wording. Review report SHA-256 is f563e231d7f77bfe0bb2814861e8aa4d7ac7c9f84420b257619a076d93d348c2.

The ten-path wording reconciliation preserved chronology and changed lifecycle wording only. Its independent delta audit passed, but the subsequent exact-candidate publication review returned BLOCKED / PUBLICATION TRANSITION DEFECT because transient pending/sole-next-gate assertions would self-invalidate on review success.

Fourth-pass internal evidence is 107 focused passes; an exact Git-backed tracked suite with 488 passes plus only the two baseline-identical absent ignored-WDI-fixture failures; passing coherence, lifecycle, explicit canonical publication-boundary, context-health, recovery, architecture-to-reality, deterministic-repeat, and diff checks; and production PostgreSQL count agreement under BEGIN READ ONLY with explicit ROLLBACK. The suite is not claimed green. Live architectural-governance testing is contaminated by preserved unrelated Git-visible artifacts, while the exact candidate export's architecture-to-reality audit is warning-free.
The mechanism provides prospective bounded reproducibility only; complete historical ignored-byte evidence is not claimed.
Provider-rights values are caller classifications and do not independently establish permission.

The published WDI correction at the authority baseline remains closed and unchanged. The final third-correction clean-export WDI nodes exactly matched the preserved baseline's two absent ignored-fixture failures; this differential grants no waiver or publication authority.

The latest blocked publication review is preserved as event 15 and as immutable external evidence: 25361 bytes, SHA-256 d728d980fdc056cfac58020443de332f7b74131c12c2d5d817b12c8d1cdd0e15, Hermes session macroforge-successor-publication-review-20260808-d728d980fdc056cf payload 192848. It remains a BLOCK and grants no publication authority.

The sixth bounded correction replaces transient live publication assertions with the closed state-conditioned publication-v1 invariant. Authenticated exact-byte PASS evidence permits bounded publication without changing candidate bytes; BLOCK requires correction; local commit still requires push and authoritative-remote verification; verified remote equality closes this workstream without implicitly activating a successor.

The repository record is intentionally a transition invariant rather than a live review verdict. Current authority is derived from authenticated Git state plus byte-recoverable external review evidence, so later review, commit, push, and verified-publication transitions do not require mutation of these candidate bytes.
